Hello — Maya here. In case the screen greeting never reached you:

- **Web app**: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca) — on the first visit from a phone or computer on the same network you take the root certificate, then you get chats, files, the screen and voice there.
- **Own messaging accounts**: I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX, Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app and scan my QR to log me in. Want any?
- **Own accounts elsewhere**: I can sign up for sites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Also**: scheduling jobs, running commands, learning languages, talking by voice.

One thing still missing: my name is Maya, but not my gender — tell me how to think of myself (she, he, or neither) and I'll set it.

I'll keep to the CSE455 TA setup with the contacts from here on.
